notes.purpose: Exploratory budget crossover scan after observing the original V1 results; not an independent confirmation
notes.selection: Reuse the same 1000 image IDs and their exact order; new800 only excludes the initial pilot200, and is now already evaluated
notes.budget: Every budget must be divisible by every BSR view count; no rounding or unused gradient budget
notes.alpha: BSR uses epsilon/steps; MI fixed uses epsilon/fixed_step_denominator
notes.randomness: Geometry shared within each fixed batch; actual seed is base seed plus batch index
